segments.text: Good morning, everyone.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: This is the planning meeting for the version 2 release of the Pearl Pay mobile app.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Omar, Lena, thanks for joining.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Morning.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: I have the test results from last week so I can start with those.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: Please go ahead.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: I found three bugs in the payment screen.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: 2 are fixed, the third one only happens on older Android phones and we are still looking at it.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: Do we know how many customers still use those phones?
segments.speaker: Guest-3

segments.text: Not yet I can pull the numbers from the analytics dashboard.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: Good, Omar, please send those numbers to the team by Wednesday.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Sure, I will send them by Wednesday.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: Next, the release date marketing ask for the 15th of March.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: The 15th works for the design team as long as the new icons are approved this week.
segments.speaker: Guest-3

segments.text: Then let's decide it.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: We release version 2 on the 15th of March.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Agreed.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: Agreed.
segments.speaker: Guest-3

segments.text: Lena, can you get the new icons approved by Friday?
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Yes, I will send them to the brand team today and get approval by Friday.
segments.speaker: Guest-3

segments.text: One more decision.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: We drop the Dark mode feature from this release and move it to version 2.1.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: That makes sense.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: It needs more testing anyway.
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: Fine with me.
segments.speaker: Guest-3

segments.text: I will update the release notes and share them with the support team next Monday.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: What about the price change for international transfers?
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: Will that be in version 2?
segments.speaker: Guest-2

segments.text: I don't know yet.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Finance hasn't confirmed it.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Let's keep that open.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: And who will present the release at the All Hands meeting?
segments.speaker: Guest-3

segments.text: Good question.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: We will come back to that.
segments.speaker: Guest-1

segments.text: Thanks everyone.
segments.speaker: Guest-1
